newsitem.title: USA: Splash to offer 3.25 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Splash to offer 3.25 million shares.

text.p: Splash Technology Holdings Inc said Monday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of 3.25 million common shares.
Splash will offer 1.25 million of the shares while the remaining 2 million shares will be offered by selling stockholders.

The offering will be managed by Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Montgomery Securities and Piper Jaffray Inc. Splash and the selling stockholders have granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 487,500 additional shares for the purpose of covering over-allotments, if any.
Shares under the overallotment option will be offered equally by the company and selling shareholders.
